name: maestro-web-showreel
description: 30 s Korean motion-graphics showreel for Maestro Web, rendered frame by frame from HTML/Canvas with headless Chrome.

scripts.capture: node scripts/capture-gameplay.mjs gameplay/perfect 0 1800 && node scripts/capture-gameplay.mjs gameplay/fail 720 1290 botfail=12
scripts.build: npm run audio && npm run render && npm run assemble && npm run web
